meaningEvidence: Exact owner-account Publer published-post record binds the 16.37-second source MP4 to this TikTok ID and caption.

All nine full-timeline source frames and the original selected poster were opened and inspected. The overlays assert a refused handshake and spitting; these are attributed claims, not verified source events.
The original source includes an audio stream. ASR produced no text; no reliable spoken quotation is used, and absence of ASR text is not represented as proof of silence.
The same vehicle, red carpet, palace facade and gestures appear in the opening portion of SVT video 8LJrXAE. Later SVT footage visibly shows handshakes indoors and in a courtyard.
Royal Court first-party visit account and exact published image show an indoor handshake in matching clothing; Ukrainian presidency independently dates the Lviv meeting to 17 April 2026.
limitations: A short edited excerpt is not the whole visit. No claim to viewing an uncut continuous arrival recording.
The post’s 22 October date is distinct from the documented 17 April visit date.
A head or mouth movement does not independently establish spitting, its destination or intent.
No assertion that this clip contains an actual handshake at 6 seconds; the inspected frame there shows open hands rather than verified contact.
No invented emotional reaction, royal-protocol rule, motive for sharing, or claim that the creator witnessed the meeting.
External photographs/video are research evidence only; public article links them without reproducing new external copyrighted media.
